images.caption: Figure 1:Illustration of the event-centric representation of audiovisual captions, where aligned audiovisual events are composed into the predicted caption.

Figure 2:Illustration of the designed data annotation pipeline, comprising three stages: initialization, refinement and event-centric quality control. Raw videos are transformed into audiovisual captions with high-fidelity audiovisual synchronization and event attributions.

Figure 4:Illustration of the event-centric alignment with GRPO for EVA-Cap.
We introduce event-centric rewards during GRPO training, focusing on three key dimensions: Global Completeness (event recall), Intra-Event Attribution (character matching), and Inter-Event Synchronization (cross-modal retrieval between audio and visual events).

Figure 5:Case analysis of EVA-Cap and AVoCaDO, with features relevant toaudiovisual synchronizationin bold, andaccurate event attributionunderlined. Incorrect event-centric alignments are marked inred, and correct ones ingreen.
